summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 49 of CipherBox (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation, expanded mid-session to include batch/drag move parity), then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security-review, security:review, CodeRabbit CLI pre-PR, CodeRabbit GitHub review post-PR via /resolve-pr-reviews), push to remote, open a PR, and kick off a CI e2e run.
summary.outcome: PR #509 opened with all 6 requirements implemented across 5 plans/3 waves; all pre-PR QA passed (LOW risk on both security reviews, 6/7 CodeRabbit CLI findings fixed, 4 GitHub review nitpicks addressed); CI e2e run revealed two failures—a real regression in SharedFileBrowser double-click navigation and a spec robustness bug—both diagnosed and fixed before the session ended.

repo: Cross-package dist staleness: web `tsc -b` checks the built SDK dist, not source — must rebuild SDK dist (`pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build`) after any public-API change before running web typecheck or the new methods appear missing.

Private vault SelectionActionBar is gated on `selectedIds.size > 1` (FileBrowser.tsx:205), so a plain single click never renders it. Shared browser initially gated on `size > 0`, which caused a mid-double-click layout shift that broke subfolder navigation — the fix is to mirror the `> 1` gate.

`getFolderItemNames()` in the shared-file-browser page object returns folder names with a trailing `/` (e.g. `'foldername/'`). The established convention in existing specs is slash-tolerant `.includes()` assertions — bare `.toContain('name')` assertions against these names will fail in CI.
`reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange` (reencrypt.ts:49) is fully key-agnostic — takes raw buffer args, no owner vs. recipient distinction — and is reusable verbatim for the shared-folder move case.

`share_keys` entries are keyed by `itemId` (file UUID), not by parent folder (download path resolves `k.keyType === 'file' && k.itemId === item.id`), so file keys do not need re-registration after a folder move.

`adoptSharedFolderResult` should only be called for the source folder result after a move, not the dest — calling it for dest would corrupt the `sharedFolderTree` projection (it filters by `shareId` only, not depth).
`SharedFolderClient` Pick allowlist (shared-folder-projection.ts:28-38) must be explicitly updated when new client methods are added — it does not auto-include new public methods.

File IPNS key for re-encryption in the shared context must come from `share_keys keyType:'file-ipns'` (recipient-wrapped), not `FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` (owner-wrapped, recipient cannot decrypt it).
The 3 `integration.test.ts` SDK failures (hitting `/auth/test-login`) are pre-existing and require a running docker stack — they also fail on `main` and are not regressions.
The web package has no `typecheck` script — use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web exec tsc -b` for web typechecking.
gsd-executor commit helpers report false `commit_failed` statuses in non-worktree mode; commits actually land and must be verified with `git log` rather than trusting the tool result.

CodeRabbit GitHub review on the CHILL profile bundles findings as review-body summary rather than inline threads — `/resolve-pr-reviews` will find 0 unresolved threads even when there are actionable findings.

code.finding: Private vault gates SelectionActionBar on `selectedIds.size > 1`, not `> 0` — single click never shows the bar, preserving double-click navigation. Shared browser must mirror this gate to avoid layout shifts mid-double-click.

SelectionActionBar rendered above the file list (between toolbar and rows), so any re-render that shows/hides it shifts all row coordinates — critical for Playwright dblclick which dispatches both clicks at fixed coordinates.

`runWrite` was changed to return `Promise<boolean>` so `batchMoveItemsHandler` can call `clearSelection()` only on success, not unconditionally — `runWrite` calls `setError(null)` on entry to clear prior errors, so `setError` IS called once even on success paths.

`enumerateSharedSubtree` DFS must zero each per-iteration `folderKey` in a try/finally block — without it, plaintext AES folder keys stay live in heap across the entire DFS traversal, violating the 'clear key material after use' rule.
`isExternalFileDrag` and `DragItem` already exist in `useDropUpload` and `FileListItem` respectively — no need to inline their implementations; import from the existing modules.
The stateless `moveInSharedFolder` op should use two separate contexts (srcCtx/destCtx) with pre-resolved key bytes, mirroring the `sdkCore.moveItem` caller pattern.

`getFolderItemNames` and `getFolderItem` return/match names with trailing `/` for folders. Normalize with `.replace(/\/$/, '')` in the page object rather than requiring every caller to handle the slash.

Adding `parentId` to `enumerateSharedSubtree` node results is non-breaking (field-access tests, not strict-shape equality) and enables the dialog's descendant-cycle exclusion logic without a separate DFS.

workflow: For AFK runs, sequential wave execution without worktrees is more reliable than parallel worktree execution — avoids merge-back protocol footguns and concurrent test RAM contention. Trade-off: slower wall clock.

CodeRabbit CLI structured review (`--agent`) returns findings as JSON with schema `{severity, fileName, codegenInstructions, suggestions}` — the field names are not `title`/`description`/`file` as one might expect.

CodeRabbit GitHub review on CHILL profile bundles nitpicks in the review body rather than inline threads, so `/resolve-pr-reviews` shows 0 threads even when there are actionable findings — address them by reading the review body directly.

Disable `commit.gpgsign` locally for AFK sessions to prevent the 1Password signer from wedging. Re-enable with `git config --local --unset commit.gpgsign`. The branch will need a signed rebase before merge if the repo enforces signatures on PRs.
UI keyword gate in gsd:plan-phase can false-positive on 'eval' appearing in e2e requirements text — non-blocking, proceed without AI-SPEC.
gsd-planner subagent cannot commit (gsd-tools not on its PATH in the subagent environment) — always commit plan revision artifacts manually after the planner/checker cycle completes.

For a scope expansion mid-planning (before the planner runs), the right time to fold it in is after research returns and before spawning the planner — update ROADMAP.md + CONTEXT.md with the expanded requirements and the exact private-vault analog references so the planner mirrors rather than invents.

The cycle-guard correctness fix (SDK self-move throw + picker descendant exclusion via parentId + drag self-guard) was a multi-layer defense: SDK layer catches direct API abuse, UI layer prevents the common case. Full authoritative recursive subtree check is proportionate to add as a follow-up when the actor doesn't already hold write keys.

friction: CodeRabbit false positive on `setError` assertion: suggested `not.toHaveBeenCalled()` but `runWrite` calls `setError(null)` on entry to clear prior errors, so `setError` IS called once on success paths — required reverting and adding an explanatory comment.
JSX comment syntax error: placing `{/* */}` inside a `{cond && (...)}` expression (not a JSX parent) causes TS1005 — had to merge the comment into the surrounding JSX block.
TS2352/TS2493 in batch test: mock call tuple inferred as `[]`, making `c[1]` fail typechecking — needed `(c as unknown as [string, { itemId: string }])[1].itemId` cast.
gsd-tools commit helper false negatives throughout execution: repeatedly reported `commit_failed` while commits actually landed, requiring `git log` verification after each wave.
Intel API surface generator returned empty output (regex extractor unpopulated) — the HINT artifact was not useful; all symbol refs had to come from RESEARCH.md instead.
Web package has no `typecheck` script — docs/workflow assume `pnpm typecheck` but the correct invocation is `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web exec tsc -b`.
CodeRabbit CLI finding schema not documented anywhere accessible — required a schema dump (`jq 'keys'`) to discover the correct field names.

Trailing `/` on folder names in `getFolderItemNames` only discovered when the e2e spec failed in CI — the page object convention was not documented and differed from the assumption made when writing the spec.
CI e2e log extraction was fragile: multiple Bash attempts with different grep patterns were needed to locate the actual Playwright failure summary block in the compressed GitHub Actions log output.
1Password signer would wedge the terminal during AFK commits — required disabling `commit.gpgsign` locally, which then required a signed rebase reminder before the PR can merge.
open_items: Commits on the branch are unsigned (signer disabled for AFK session). The repo enforces signed commits on PRs — needs a signed rebase (`git rebase --exec 'git commit --amend --no-edit -S' main`) or admin override before merge. Re-enable signing first: `git config --local --unset commit.gpgsign`.

REQ-5 live e2e UAT (`shared-folder-move.spec.ts` two-account decrypt-survival test) is main-push gated — the test is authored and type-checked but requires the local docker stack (postgres/ipfs/redis) to actually run.

Full authoritative SDK subtree cycle check: current guards are UI-layer (picker descendant exclusion via parentId) + SDK self-move throw. A crafted client could still call `moveInSharedFolder` to move a folder into its own descendant. Deferred since actor already holds write keys — documented in PR as optional follow-up.

Batch key-refetch: each `moveInSharedFolder` call in `batchMoveItemsHandler` independently re-fetches share_keys — parity-acceptable for v1 but a meaningful perf regression for large selections. Flagged as follow-up.
DFS concurrency in `enumerateSharedSubtree`: currently sequential to avoid gateway rate-limiting. Could be parallelized with a bounded concurrency pool. Flagged as follow-up.

`useMultiSelect` extraction: both SharedFileBrowser and FileBrowser manage multi-select state with similar patterns. Deferred as cross-boundary scope creep — appropriate for a dedicated refactor phase.

SelectionActionBar Delete/Download actions for shared view: currently hidden (props made optional, not passed from SharedFileBrowser) since those operations are not yet implemented for shared folders. Will need wiring when supported.
CI e2e failures were fixed locally but the fixes were not yet pushed at the transcript cutoff — confirm push and re-run to verify green before merge.
